```lean
theorem lg_target (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) : (a + b) * (1 / a + 1 / b) ≥ 4 := by
  have h1 : (a + b) * (1 / a + 1 / b) = 2 + a / b + b / a :=
    by rw [one_div_add_one_div, mul_add, add_mul, mul_one, add_assoc, add_left_comm, add_self]
  have h2 : a / b + b / a ≥ 2 :=
    by apply Real.am_gm; exact ⟨(a / b).pos, (b / a).pos⟩
  rw [h1] at h2
  linarith
```
